verses.t: I do not worship what you worship
verses.pickthall: I worship not that which ye worship

verses.t: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship
verses.pickthall: Nor worship ye that which I worship

verses.t: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship
verses.pickthall: And I shall not worship that which ye worship

verses.t: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship
verses.pickthall: Nor will ye worship that which I worship

verses.t: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion
verses.pickthall: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion
